# Stuart Collection

> Site-specific artworks by leading contemporary artists, commissioned for the campus of the University of California San Diego (UCSD), La Jolla, California. Free and open to the public.

The Stuart Collection enriches the UC San Diego campus through commissioned site-specific sculptures and installations by some of the most significant artists of our time. Each work is conceived for its particular location on campus, and the collection as a whole can be visited freely, on foot, at any time.

## Main sections

- [Home](/): Introduction to the Stuart Collection, featured artworks and visiting information
- [The Collection](/collection/): Complete catalogue of artworks, browsable by artwork, artist, location and trail
- [Artwork pages](/collection/artwork/): One page per commissioned artwork, with artist, year, location, description, images and visiting details
- [Trails](/collection/trail/): Curated walking routes connecting several artworks across campus

## About the content

- **Primary language:** English
- **Subject:** Public art, contemporary sculpture, site-specific installations, campus art collection
- **Content type:** Artwork catalogue pages, artist information, visiting information, curated walking trails
- **Authorship:** Stuart Collection, University of California San Diego

## Usage

Content from this site may be indexed by AI crawlers to improve the accuracy of answers about the Stuart Collection, its artworks and artists. Standard site terms of use apply.
